title: Domain witnesses for the smooth tower tensor adjoint
statement: Fix a PurityFiniteSetting P, its normalized strict-tower Base b, Operations o and Coordinates q. Let X,Y be separated finite-type schemes over the algebraic closure in P, let f:X→Y be smooth separated of pure relative dimension d, and let c be a compactification. Suppose the given compact-support functor preserves the full uniform constructible finite-Tor subcategories and is left adjoint to a given G between them. Then there exist normalized TensorData on X and Y and a proof that the actual inverse-realized coefficient unit belongs to C_Y. For every K in C_Y, f* K tensor G(unit), in the fixed section-preserving ordinary derived tower coordinates, inverse-realizes into C_X; moreover the specified compactification projection PF_(G(unit),K) is invertible. No retagging, orientation, normalization of K, counit-comparison or transpose-comparison hypothesis is required.

source.place: Clause (2), existence of the inverse-projection composite and its tensor source; the domain-witness part of retagging Step 3.

proof.text: Use the normalized K-flat sequence-site tensor models to obtain the signed symmetry and scalar unit data on X and Y. The actual coefficient unit has common cohomological and Tor interval [0,0], with constructible levels, so its inverse realization belongs to C_Y. These are precisely the tensorX, tensorY and unit_mem witnesses appearing in the gamma package.

Construct the exceptional adjoint with its chart counits using tower gluing. Canonical compactification comparison and uniqueness of right adjoints identify its representing pair with the given adjunction for c. Applying the smooth tower gamma construction and retaining only tensor_mem and projection_iso provides the required predicates for the given G. Equivalently, the chart description identifies G(unit) locally with a shifted locally free rank-one tower; tensoring the smooth pullback of K translates both uniform bounds by -2d. The finite projection formula at each coefficient level and tower conservativity make the specified projection invertible. No orientation equation, retagging equation or comparison of transposes is asserted.

theorem tensor_adjoint_domains
    (X Y : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of P.field.k))) (f : X ⟶ Y) (d : ℕ)
    [IsSeparated X.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom]
    [IsSeparated Y.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom]
    [IsSeparated f.left] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f.left]
    (c : Compactification f.left)
    (hF : ∀ M : SpTowerCalculus.C P.coefficients.l P.extension b q X.left,
      spConstructibleTorTowers P.coefficients.l P.extension Y.left (q.abelian Y.left)
        ((SpTowerCalculus.F P.coefficients.l P.extension b o q c).obj M.obj))
    (G : SpTowerCalculus.C P.coefficients.l P.extension b q Y.left ⥤
      SpTowerCalculus.C P.coefficients.l P.extension b q X.left)
    (adj : SpTowerGluing.support P.coefficients.l P.extension b o q c hF ⊣ G) :
    ∃ tx : SpTowerP1.TensorData P.coefficients.l P.extension b X.left,
    ∃ ty : SpTowerP1.TensorData P.coefficients.l P.extension b Y.left,
    ∃ hU : spConstructibleTorTowers P.coefficients.l P.extension Y.left (q.abelian Y.left)
      (SpTowerGamma.originalUnit P.coefficients.l P.extension b q Y.left),
    ∀ K : SpTowerCalculus.C P.coefficients.l P.extension b q Y.left,
      spConstructibleTorTowers P.coefficients.l P.extension X.left (q.abelian X.left)
        ((SpTowerCalculus.realization P.coefficients.l P.extension b X.left
          (q.abelian X.left)).inverse.obj
          ((SpTowerGamma.tensorSource P.coefficients.l P.extension b o q f.left
            ((SpTowerGamma.exceptional P.coefficients.l P.extension b q G).obj
              ⟨SpTowerGamma.originalUnit P.coefficients.l P.extension b q Y.left,
                hU⟩)).obj K)) ∧
      IsIso (SpTowerShriek.projection P.coefficients.l P.extension b o c
        ((SpTowerGamma.exceptional P.coefficients.l P.extension b q G).obj
          ⟨SpTowerGamma.originalUnit P.coefficients.l P.extension b q Y.left, hU⟩)
        ((SpTowerGamma.realization P.coefficients.l P.extension b q Y.left).obj K))
